zh: IraStoria，作曲與遊戲音訊設計者。長期關注「音樂如何回應互動」：不是把音樂貼在畫面上，而是讓音樂本身有結構地跟著玩家的節奏走。
目前同時在做一款節奏遊戲與自製的 DAW／製譜工具。這個網站收錄作品、可操作的概念展示，以及零散的筆記。
en: IraStoria — composer and game audio designer. My long-running interest is how music responds to interaction: not pasting music onto a screen, but letting the music itself follow the player's rhythm in a structured way.
I am currently working on a rhythm game and a home-grown DAW / notation tool. This site collects works, hands-on concept demos, and scattered notes.

click._note: click-to-enter easter egg (fires with probability `chance`). Full-screen boot: x/y = viewport position (centre, nudged right). sound_at = video time where the sound's onset lands. clip plays → vanishes → after_ms → desktop loads.

boot._note: plays when the boot screen appears IF the browser allows sound without a gesture (returning visitors / engaged origins); otherwise it plays on the boot click instead
